description: Powerful motor, long-lasting battery, step-through convenience, and smart features, the Skyline takes your commuting experience to new heights.

components.description: Provides instant responsiveness and increased stopping power, with less wear and tear to keep you safe in all riding conditions.

The brushless geared hub motor powers your ride with 350W of continuous power output. The 36V, 10.4Ah Lithium-ion battery provides up to 40 mile range per charge. Forget about steep hills or long distances, Skyline has you covered.
Pops in and out easily , this 36V, 10.4Ah battery ranges up to 40 miles can be fully charged in 2-3 hours with the included 3 Amp fast Charger.
The LCD Smart Display features a speedometer, odometer, battery indicator, and backlighting. Easily switch from 5-level pedal assist, throttle, and traditional cycling mode.
Equipped with a robust 350W geared hub motor , the Skyline effortlessly propels you forward, making your daily commute a breeze.
The front LED headlight, rear taillight, and integrated reflectors all ensure high-visibility for safe riding.
The sturdy rear rack holds up to 55lb/25kg, while the fender protect you away from mud and rain, and the strong aluminum kickstand keeps the bike stable and supported.
Customize your ride with Shimano 7-speed gearing for quick and precise gear changes. Excel in any terrain with ease using more responsive torque.
26" x 1.75" CST Tires from a well-know brand provides excellent grip in all surface conditions from city commuting to excursion riding.

The Skyline's sleek and modern design is a perfect reflection of your urban lifestyle. Whether you're commuting to work, meeting friends for coffee, or running errands around town, this bike is a stylish companion that turns heads wherever you go. With its functionality and eye-catching aesthetics, the Skyline is the perfect blend of form and function.

Ride comfortably anywhere. Featuring an adjustable handlebar stem and seatpost, tailor your fit to achieve custom comfort. Low step-thru frame design allows for easy hop on and off, ensuring Skyline fits you perfectly whether commuting or cruising.
